reviews.review_description:
I am so glad I saw this 99p. App.  How handy it is to have at had to memorise a code or a game, or a name is priceless to me.  I was looking for a writing pad and saw this.  99p.  And upto 500 characters,  literally it's something I use daily to remember something I saw while using my headset. Love it.  5 star for me. Thank you.
Worth so much more to me. Than 99p.
It works but the the interface is small.  1000 character max per note.  If you go back to edit a note the interface is even smaller.
